projects.name: ODOT TransGIS - STIP 2027-2030 Lines - Current
projects.notes: ODOT 2027-2030 STIP projects mapped as lines, refreshed daily (GIS_PRC_DT was 11/16/2026). No work-type field: the type of work is only in PROJ_DESC free text. MNTR_CD is the monitor code: PSEDOC = still in design (plans/specs/estimate), CONST = construction phase. BID_LET_DT (epoch ms) is the bid letting date; future date = not yet let. STIP_FIRST_YR_NO / PROJ_PHASE_CURRENT_STIP_YR_NO give the STIP year. ADMINISTRATOR_ID tells ODOT vs LOCAL delivery. Layer ids in this large catalog service are not guaranteed stable; re-find by layer name if 417 changes.

projects.name: ODOT TransGIS - STIP 2027-2030 Points - Current
projects.notes: Point version (spot locations) of the 2027-2030 STIP; same schema.

projects.name: ODOT TransGIS - STIP 2024-2027 Lines
projects.notes: Current-cycle 2024-2027 STIP lines, same schema; many already let or under construction, so filter on BID_LET_DT in the future and MNTR_CD. Points are layer 361.

projects.name: ODOT STIP 2027-2030 Draft Lines (public comment map)
projects.notes: Draft 27-30 STIP layer with a plain phase field STATUS (Planning / Design / Construction / Other) and PROGRAMMED Yes/No; no cost or dates. Join to the TransGIS layers on PROJ_KEY_NO. Points are layer 0.

parcels_statewide_note: null: no free statewide Oregon taxlot layer with owner names found. Portland Metro's regional RLIS 'Taxlots (Public)' covers Multnomah, Washington and Clackamas counties but has no owner name (only PUBLIC_OWN / OWNERTYPE).

parcels_counties.name: Lane County - PlanMaps/AddressParcel - Parcels
parcels_counties.restrictions: None seen on the layer; ORS 192.355 / county terms not reviewed.
parcels_counties.notes: County's own server (Eugene/Springfield). Owner fields were blank on the first sample record, see owner_filled_count. No situs address field in this layer (addresses are layer 0 of the same service, not inspected). ASSDTOTVAL = assessed total; LANDVAL, IMPVAL also present.

parcels_counties.name: Marion County parcels (copy published by City of Stayton: Parcels)
parcels_counties.notes: Third-party city copy of Marion County (Salem) assessor parcels, 115k records, LASTUPDATE Feb 2025 in the sample, so not live. RMVTOTAL = real market value; SALEPRICE, INSTDATE also present.

summary: ODOT STIP 2027-2030 and 2024-2027 line/point layers verified with cost, bid-let date and design/construction code (no structured work-type field). Parcels: no statewide owner layer; Lane County and a city-hosted copy of Marion County verified. Multnomah/Washington/Clackamas (Metro RLIS) have no owner names in public layers; portlandmaps.com timed out.
